candidates.title: DynamoServe: A Distributed Tiered Memory System for Multi-tenant LLM Serving
candidates.reason: stranded GPU memoryへweights/KVをoffloadしfragmentation緩和とcoordinated placement・demand-driven weight migrationを統合するmulti-tenant tiered-memory serving system。

candidates.title: DeltaLog: Deferred Materialization of Recurrent States for Linear Attention Decoding
candidates.reason: linear-attention recurrent stateをdense base＋bounded compact-update logとして保持しfull-state write-backを遅延。write traffic最大7.83倍削減、end-to-end 1.05–1.20倍高速化。

candidates.title: TurboBus: Pooling PCIe Bandwidth for LLM Workloads via Scale-Up Fabrics
candidates.reason: GPU memory offloadで遊休PCIe linkをscale-up fabric越しにpoolしrelay GPU経由で共有。model loading first-token latency最大40%削減、KV-offloaded inference throughput最大1.6倍。

candidates.title: Replacing NVMe Staging in LLM Inference with a High-Bandwidth CXL Memory Expander with an On-Device DMA Controller
candidates.reason: NVMe stagingをon-device DMA付きCXL memory expanderへ置換しGPU HBMとのPCIe P2PをNIXL backendで実装。51GB/s read・33GB/s writeを実測しSSD階層との比較に直接有用。

candidates.title: RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention
candidates.reason: mixed-precision weights・disk expert offload・3-bit KV IsoQuantとpacked attention kernelを統合し、Qwen3-30B-A3Bを16GB、120B MoEを32GBで9–19 tok/s実行。

discovery_stats.axis: forward citations of FlexGen offload and hierarchical-memory LLM inference
